input.question: In which city did Conry practice law?

documents.text: was born in Brookline, Massachusetts, on September 12, 1868. He attended the common schools, studied law, was admitted to the bar and commenced practice in New York City. Municipal government [edit] Conry served from 1895 through 1897 as a member of the Boston Common Council from ward 2. He served as president of the Common Council in 1896 and 1897. [1] Conry served on the Boston Board of Aldermen in 1898, and was the chairman of the board. [1] United States Congress [edit]
